description: Source code for string utility functions, including path manipulation, pattern matching, quoting, and directory traversal, with some platform-specific implementations.

methods.name: mkdtemp
methods.description: Creates a temporary directory with a unique name based on a template string.

methods.name: strcasestr
methods.description: Case-insensitive version of strstr() for string search.

methods.name: count_chars_to_escape
methods.description: Counts how many characters in a string need to be escaped based on a set of meta characters.

methods.name: xa_escape_common_chars
methods.description: Escapes common characters in a string with a prefix.

methods.name: xa_unescape_common_chars
methods.description: Unescapes characters in a string that were previously escaped with a prefix.

methods.name: xa_strip_current_working_dir_from_path
methods.description: Removes the current working directory prefix from a path if present.

methods.name: xa_remove_slash_from_path
methods.description: Removes trailing slash from a path string.

methods.name: xa_escape_bad_chars
methods.description: Escapes bad characters in a string based on a pattern.

methods.name: xa_unescape_bad_chars
methods.description: Unescapes previously escaped characters in a string.

methods.name: xa_remove_level_from_path
methods.description: Removes the last directory level from a path.

methods.name: xa_set_window_title
methods.description: Sets the window title based on a pathname.

methods.name: match_patterns
methods.description: Matches a string against a list of patterns with flags.

methods.name: xa_collect_filenames
methods.description: Collects filenames from an archive, adjusting paths based on archive settings.

methods.name: xa_slist_copy
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of a GSList of strings.

methods.name: xa_recurse_local_directory
methods.description: Recursively traverses a directory, optionally including files and subdirectories.

methods.name: xa_local_directory_uris
methods.description: Lists directory contents as URIs.

methods.name: xa_quote_filenames
methods.description: Quotes filenames for shell safety, with optional escaping.

methods.name: xa_quote_shell_command
methods.description: Quotes a shell command string, escaping quotes.

methods.name: xa_quote_dir_contents
methods.description: Quotes directory contents for shell commands.

methods.name: xa_collect_files_in_dir
methods.description: Recursively collects all files in a directory and subdirectories.

methods.name: xa_set_max_width_chars_ellipsize
methods.description: Ellipsizes a UTF-8 string to a maximum width with different modes.

methods.name: xa_make_full_path
methods.description: Constructs a full path from a filename, prepending current directory if needed.
